claims.evidence: Witness photos show a blue motorcycle (MX X100) but do not show usage history or what 'giveaway' means.

claims.claim: Okay buy and drive to any location
claims.evidence: Photos do not confirm roadworthiness or that it starts/runs reliably.
No clear photo of the battery condition/fitment or a running test; only exterior views are shown.

risks.risk: Engine may not start or may have weak compression; photos cannot confirm starting, idling, or power.
risks.proof: Short video clip of cold start + 2–3 minutes idling, then a slow ride showing smooth throttle response.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not confirmed running/roadworthy (worst-case: needs engine check/repair).

risks.risk: Brakes and lights/indicators/horn may be faulty or worn; photos cannot confirm function.
risks.proof: Video showing brake test (front+rear), turn signals left/right, horn, headlight high/low, and tail light working.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially needing electrical/brake service (worst-case: replace pads/shoes and fix lights).

risks.risk: Tires and brake pads/shoes may be near-worn or cracked; photos only show general condition.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of tire tread depth/sidewall cracks + close-up of brake pads/shoes thickness.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as needing tire/brake wear items (worst-case: tires and pads/shoes).

risks.risk: Accident damage or bent frame/chassis may exist; exterior dirt/wear can hide structural issues.
risks.proof: Straight-edge/visual alignment check video (front wheel alignment, fork straightness) and under-seat/frame inspection photos.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as possible frame/fork issue (worst-case: alignment/repair).

risks.risk: Ownership/registration documents may be missing or mismatched; photos do not show VIN/chassis/receipt.
risks.proof: Clear photos of receipt, VIN/chassis number plate, and current registration status; show VIN matches the bike.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as document risk (worst-case: buyer may face inability to register/transfer).

risks.risk: Fuel system/battery health may be poor (rusty tank, carb/ignition issues, weak battery); photos cannot confirm.
risks.proof: Video of starting after a few hours + brief rev test; photos of battery label/condition and carb/air filter area.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as possible fuel/battery service needed (worst-case: carb/ignition/battery replacement).

proof_requests: Send a short cold-start video (start + 2–3 minutes idle) and a slow test ride.
Show working lights: headlight (high/low), indicators (left/right), horn, and brake light (front+rear).
Provide close-up photos of tire tread/sidewalls and brake pads/shoes thickness.
Provide photos of VIN/chassis number and receipt/registration documents (and confirm they match).
Show battery condition (close-up) and a quick rev/charging check video if possible.
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies the motorcycle as an MX X100 and provides multiple exterior angles, so a worst-case price can be set despite missing functional and document proof.
